scenario.title: 朋友心情不好，怎麼回應
scenario.context: 朋友抱怨時，他需要的通常不是解決方法，而是被理解。英文最常用 That must be… 表達同理：「那一定很辛苦」。這裡的 must 不是「必須」，而是「推測」，是台灣人比較少用、但母語者天天在用的用法。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Can I vent for a minute?

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: My boss took credit for my idea in front of the whole team.
lines.zh: 我老闆在整個團隊面前把我的點子說成是他的。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Ugh, that sucks. You must be so frustrated.
lines.zh: 唉，太爛了。你一定很沮喪。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: I am. And I can't even say anything because he's my boss.
lines.zh: 對啊。而且我什麼都不能說，因為他是我老闆。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: That must be really hard. Has he done this before?
lines.zh: 那一定很難受。他之前也這樣過嗎？

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Twice. I'm starting to think it's on purpose.
lines.zh: 兩次了。我開始覺得他是故意的。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Do you want advice, or do you just need me to listen?
lines.zh: 你想聽建議，還是只需要我聽你說？

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Just listen for now. Thanks for asking.

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Hey, how are you holding up?

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Better. Rough day yesterday, but I slept on it.
lines.zh: 好多了。昨天很難熬，但我睡一覺冷靜下來了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: You must have a lot on your mind with the promotion coming up, too.
lines.zh: 升遷的事快到了，你心裡一定也很多事。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Exactly. I think I'll talk to HR next week.
lines.zh: 就是。我想下週去找人資談。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: That sounds like a good plan. Hang in there.

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Thanks. Drinks on me when this is over.
lines.zh: 謝謝。這事結束後我請你喝一杯。

patterns.en: I'm sorry you're going through that.
patterns.zh: 很遺憾你正在經歷這些。

patterns.en: Do you want advice, or should I just listen?
patterns.zh: 你想聽建議，還是我聽就好？
patterns.note: 英文圈很推崇的貼心問法

patterns.en: I'm here if you need to talk.
Take all the time you need.

chinglish.right: Try not to overthink it. / That's a lot to deal with.
chinglish.why: 「不要想太多」直翻聽起來像在否定對方的感受。英文會先同理，再溫和地給建議。

chinglish.right: You must be tired. / You must feel tired.
chinglish.why: must 後面接原形，be 和 feel 只能擇一。

chinglish.right: You've got this! / Hang in there!
chinglish.why: 「加油」直翻 fighting 在英文裡是「打架」。鼓勵人說 You've got this / Hang in there。

chinglish.wrong: It's OK, everybody is the same.
chinglish.right: I've been there too. It's really tough.
chinglish.why: 「大家都一樣」可能讓對方覺得被輕忽。分享自己也經歷過，比說大家都這樣更有同理心。

grammar.title: must 推測現在：That must be…
grammar.oneLiner: must 除了「必須」，還有「一定是（很有把握的推測）」的意思，用來表達同理最自然。
whenToUse: must + be / 原形：根據線索的強烈推測。You must be tired.（你一定很累）
That must be + 形容詞：同理對方的處境。That must be frustrating.
can't be：很有把握的否定推測。That can't be right.（那不可能是對的）
might / could / may + 原形：不太確定的推測。He might be busy.
推測過去的事用 must have + p.p.（第 46 單元會詳細講）。
注意：推測的否定不是 mustn't，而是 can't。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 台灣人學 must 時，幾乎只學到「必須」，所以 You must be tired 常被誤以為是「你必須很累」。另外，表達同理時中文會說「辛苦了」，英文沒有對應的固定說法，That must be hard 就是最接近的一句。推測否定用 mustn't 也是常見錯誤，那樣意思會變成「禁止」。

examples.correct: You've been working all night. You must be exhausted.
examples.note: 有線索（整晚工作）→ 強烈推測。

examples.correct: He's not answering. He might be in a meeting.
You must be Jess's sister. You look just like her!

quiz.question: You just flew in from New York? You ___ be jet-lagged.
quiz.explanation: 有線索的強烈推測用 must。

quiz.question: That ___ be right. The restaurant closed years ago.
Your boss yelled at you in front of everyone? That must ___ awful.
I'm not sure where Tom is. He ___ be at the gym.
Which one expresses sympathy?
quiz.explanation: That must be hard = 那一定很辛苦。

slang.usage: 把情緒說出來。Can I vent? / I just need to vent.

examples.en: Sorry, I just needed to vent.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我只是需要發洩一下。

examples.en: She called me to vent about her roommate.

slang.usage: 朋友之間表達同情或不滿。

risk.note: 很口語，對長輩、主管、客戶避免；改說 That's unfortunate / I'm sorry to hear that。

examples.en: Your flight got canceled? That sucks.
examples.zh: 你的班機被取消了？太慘了。

examples.en: It sucks that we have to work on Saturday.
examples.zh: 週六還要上班真的很爛。

slang.usage: Rough day? 可以用來關心別人。也有 rough week / rough patch（低潮期）。

examples.zh: 你看起來很累，今天很難熬嗎？

examples.en: We're going through a rough patch, but we'll be OK.
examples.zh: 我們正經歷低潮期，但會沒事的。

slang.usage: 鼓勵正在經歷困難的人。

examples.en: Only two more days until the deadline. Hang in there!
examples.zh: 只剩兩天就截稿了，撐住！

examples.en: I know it's hard right now, but hang in there.
examples.zh: 我知道現在很難，但撐下去。

review.question: I'd rather ___ about it tomorrow.
review.explanation: 複習第 34 單元：would rather + 原形。

review.question: Today was the ___ (bad) day of my week.
The coworker ___ took my idea is getting promoted.
review.explanation: 複習第 31 單元：指人用 who。

review.question: Do you know ___?
review.explanation: 複習第 27 單元：間接問句用肯定語序。

review.question: ___ sweet of you to call!
review.explanation: 複習第 19 單元：How + 形容詞 + of you。

review.question: I'm ___ the bus now. I'll call you when I get home.
review.explanation: 複習第 3 單元：公車用 on。

review.question: Your friend's cat is sick. You say:
options: That must be so worrying. I'm sorry.
review.explanation: 用 That must be… 表達同理。
